title: Todoist launched an import tool for burned Microsoft To Do users.
summary: The company’s CEO, Amir Salihefendić, took to X to let anyone let down by Microsoft’s plans to shut down To Do (née Wunderlist) know that Todoist was waiting to welcome them with open arms.
